newsitem.title: USA: Zitel up on short squeeze, Soros speculation.
newsitem.headline: Zitel up on short squeeze, Soros speculation.

text.p: Zitel Inc shares rose sharply Tuesday, gaining six percent in unsually busy Nasdaq trade and extending a four-session rally traders attributed to a "short squeeze" and rumored investing by financier George Soros.
Emerald Research analyst Joe Besecker pointed to a recent combination of a short squeeze and a pattern of buying by an institution, or institutions, in recent days.
By late morning, Zitel was up 2-3/4 at 48-1/2, giving back about half of the earlier gain that put the stock at an all-time high 50-1/2 earlier in the Nasdaq session.
